# National Homeschool Music Ensembles (NHME)

> > NHME provides nonprofit music education through band, orchestra, and choir ensembles for homeschool students in Southeast Michigan.

Founded by Donald Dobrosky and Katherine Johnson, NHME serves homeschool families across Lenawee, Monroe, and Washtenaw Counties with classes in Tecumseh and Ann Arbor. The organization offers comprehensive music education from beginner through advanced levels, emphasizing ensemble performance and music theory.

## Key Topics

- homeschool music education
- band and orchestra ensembles
- beginning band and strings
- instrument selection and sizing
- Yamaha and Conn-Selmer instruments
- music theory fundamentals
- ensemble performance techniques
- Southeast Michigan (Tecumseh, Ann Arbor)
- youth music ensembles
- practice techniques
- intonation and tone quality
- music and brain development
- beginner musicians guide
- Donald Dobrosky and Katherine Johnson (founders)

## About NHME

- [National Homeschool Music Ensembles](https://www.nhme.org): Homepage for NHME nonprofit music education in SE Michigan
- [About National Homeschool Music Ensembles NHME](https://www.nhme.org/about.html): NHME's history, mission, and founders Dobrosky & Johnson
- [Homschool Music Class Descriptions](https://www.nhme.org/descriptions.html): Overview of NHME's band, orchestra, and choir ensemble offerings
- [Where We Meet](https://www.nhme.org/locations.html): NHME class locations in Tecumseh and Ann Arbor, Michigan
- [Contact NHME](https://www.nhme.org/contact.html): Contact form and registration info for NHME music programs
- [Ratings and Reviews](https://www.nhme.org/reviews.html): Student and alumni testimonials about NHME programs

## Getting Started with Music

- [Beginning Ensembles](https://www.nhme.org/beginningdetails.html): Details on Beginning Band and Beginner Strings group classes at NHME
- [Homeschool Music Instrument Selection](https://www.nhme.org/choosing.html): Guide to selecting band and orchestra instruments for beginners
- [About Musical Instruments](https://www.nhme.org/instruments.html): Guide to purchasing and inspecting instruments; Yamaha, Conn-Selmer brands
- [Pick Quality Affordable Musical Instruments](https://www.nhme.org/quality.html): Warning guide on avoiding sub-standard instruments; Yamaha, Selmer recommended
- [Stringed Instrument Sizing](https://www.nhme.org/stringsize.html): Sizing guide for violin, viola, cello, and double bass instruments

## Performance and Practice Guides

- [How to Practice](https://www.nhme.org/practicing.html): Best practices and techniques for effective home music practice
- [Excellent Ensemble Playing](https://www.nhme.org/elements.html): Guide to ensemble performance techniques: intonation, rhythm, tone quality
- [Articulations in Music](https://www.nhme.org/articulations.html): Music theory primer on articulation markings: staccato, legato, accents
- [Circle of Fifths](https://www.nhme.org/circletheory.html): Music theory primer on Circle of Fifths and key signatures

## Educational Benefits and Research

- [Six Benefits of Music Lessons](https://www.nhme.org/sixbenefits.html): Article by Angela Kwan on educational benefits of music lessons
- [Faster Growing Brains](https://www.nhme.org/braindevelopment.html): USC Brain Institute research on music education and brain development
- [Reasons to Study Music](https://www.nhme.org/musicstudies.html): Forbes article: 20 reasons to major in music at college
